About VFX VFX Financial is one of the UK’s fastest-growing FinTechs, helping complex organisations move, manage, and protect money across borders. Built for specialist sectors, multi-jurisdiction structures, and high-compliance environments, we support businesses whose needs go beyond standard banking.

We’re selective about who we work with because exceptional service requires focus and commitment.

With six international offices, five regulatory licences, and an 83% CAGR over the past three years, we’re scaling rapidly and earning industry recognition along the way — including the Financial Times FT1000: Europe’s Fastest Growing Companies 2026, CNBC UK’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, Wealth & Finance FinTech Awards 2026, and the Business Growth Award from Business Awards UK.

Behind it all is a team of ambitious VFXers united by collective ownership, a focus on growth, and a shared passion for solving complex problems. About the Role VFX Financial is a regulated fintech providing payments, foreign exchange, treasury services, and multi-currency accounts.

We have deployed enterprise LLM tooling organisation-wide (Claude Enterprise) across all teams, but lack dedicated resource to drive adoption, govern use, and deliver production automations. This hire owns the AI adoption and automation delivery mandate. This is primarily an AI adoption and automation delivery role—not a data engineering role.

The engineer will work closely with Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Technology teams to identify automation opportunities, build production-grade solutions, and ensure every deployment is safe, governed, and measurable.

Data pipeline engineering and Snowflake modelling sit with the data engineering team; this role uses the data platform as a consumer and integration point. The tech stack includes Azure, Power Automate, Python, the Claude API, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

The engineer operates within the AI governance framework owned by Compliance, Risk, and the DPO, contributing technical evidence and controls, not setting policy. This role can be hybrid at our office in Portimao or fully remote across Portugal.

Key Responsibilities AI Adoption & Use-Case Delivery Work with business stakeholders across Operations, Finance, and Technology to identify, prioritise, and scope AI and automation use cases Maintain and manage the AI use-case register, including intake, prioritisation, status tracking, and outcomes measurement Drive adoption of deployed AI tools (Claude Enterprise and equivalents) — structured rollout, training, and usage measurement by function Stay current on enterprise LLM and AI tooling developments; advise the Data & AI Lead on relevant capabilities Automation Engineering Design and build production-grade automations using Power Automate, Python, and API integrations, targeting operational workflows across payments, FX, treasury, onboarding, and internal operations Build and maintain automated workflows and AI pipelines with human-in-the-loop controls, escalation paths, and audit trails Integrate LLM workflows with internal systems and third-party APIs using the Claude API or equivalent enterprise LLM APIs; Document all automations with clear operational runbooks; ensure solutions are maintainable by others Production Controls & Governance Apply production engineering standards to all AI deployments: secrets management, prompt and model versioning, evaluation datasets, output quality thresholds, and observability Implement cost monitoring and usage controls for LLM API consumption Build and maintain rollback and kill-switch mechanisms for all production AI workflows Apply personal data minimisation principles — no personal data in prompts unless explicitly reviewed and approved Produce the technical input for vendor, security, privacy, and data-residency assessments for any new AI tool or integration, working with the relevant control functions Operate within the AI governance framework; provide technical evidence and control documentation to Compliance, Risk, Security, and the DPO as required Maintain awareness of AI regulatory developments, including the EU AI Act timetable, and flag implications to the Data & AI Lead and Compliance SOP & Process Redesign Work with Operations to review existing SOPs and identify where automation can reduce manual effort, error risk, or processing time Where automation is not yet appropriate, document improved manual processes that are automation-ready Measure and report on automation impact — hours saved, error reduction, throughput improvements Requirements Essential 3–6 years of hands-on software or automation engineering experience Proficiency in Python (e.g. scripting, API integration, workflow automation) Practical experience building with enterprise LLM APIs, such as Claude API, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent Experience with Power Automate or equivalent low-code/no-code automation platforms in a production context Ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate into working solutions Understanding of production controls: secrets management, versioning, observability, error handling, and rollback Strong written English (e.g. documentation, runbooks, and stakeholder communication) Preferred Experience with agentic AI patterns and multi-step LLM workflows with human oversight Background in financial services, payments, or another regulated sector Familiarity with Azure services used as integration and compute infrastructure Experience with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem as an integration target (Graph API, Teams, SharePoint) Awareness of AI governance frameworks and practical privacy controls for LLM deployments Benefits at VFX We offer more than just perks—we offer ownership.

Our benefits include: Generous Profit Share Plan (PSP) Potential Equity opportunities via the Company Share Option Plan (CSOP) Competitive salary Annual all-expenses paid company incentive trip abroad Flexible learning & development budget PSP & CSOP Details At VFX, the biggest benefit is the opportunity to act like an owner.

Through our Profit Share Scheme (PSP) , every team member has a stake in the business by sharing in the profits. To show you what that looks like, in 2025, PSP participants received over £1,000,000.

Historically, VFX has also offered equity opportunities via Company Share Option Plan (CSOP) ,where more than 80% of eligible VFXers chose to become shareholders — a powerful reflection of the belief and commitment that drives VFX forward.

If you care about building something meaningful, take pride in your work, and are motivated by impact — you’ll thrive here. Next Steps If you are successful, you will be contacted for an initial call with our People Ops Team, followed by a 1st stage Teams interview with the hiring manager, with a final Teams interview with the CTO.

Senior Business Analyst / Data Quality Assurance Engineer — Federal Healthcare Location: Remote Clearance: Active DoD Secret clearance Employment Type: Full-time Turn Complex Healthcare Data into Trusted, Mission-Ready Solutions Join Rackner to improve the quality, reliability, and usability of data supporting mission-critical federal healthcare systems.

This is a QA-focused role with requirements support. You will partner with analysts, engineers, product owners, and subject-matter experts to validate healthcare data, applications, reports, APIs, and integrations across the delivery lifecycle. You will do more than execute predefined test cases.

You will help shape test strategy, build and maintain automated tests, investigate data issues with SQL, and connect requirements to measurable validation outcomes. Business need → testable requirement → validated data → trusted release In this role, you will: Own testing activities from planning through defect resolution and release validation.

Build technical depth across SQL, databases, ETL processes, APIs, and cloud applications. Strengthen automated testing, data profiling, traceability, and quality practices. Support healthcare systems where accurate, secure, and dependable data matters.

What You’ll Do Review business and technical requirements and translate them into clear test conditions, acceptance criteria, and validation strategies. Support requirements development through stakeholder discussions, user stories, process analysis, and backlog refinement.

Build, execute, and maintain automated and manual tests using established tools and frameworks. Develop test plans and test cases for healthcare data, applications, reports, APIs, and user interfaces. Validate data-ingestion and ETL processes by comparing source data, transformation rules, and target outputs.

Write SQL queries and joins to investigate data quality, confirm business rules, and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or unexpected records. Perform functional, system, integration, regression, component, and performance testing. Maintain traceability between requirements, test coverage, defects, and delivery outcomes.

Support user-acceptance testing, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution. Partner with developers, analysts, product owners, and subject-matter experts to resolve complex application and data issues. Document test results, risks, defects, and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Help improve testing tools, methodologies, and automation strategies. What You’ll Bring Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, data science, engineering, or a related discipline—or equivalent relevant experience.

Five or more years supporting software testing, data-quality assurance, business analysis, or requirements validation in complex systems environments. Hands-on ability to build, execute, and maintain automated and manual tests. Background developing test plans, test cases, test scripts, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Proficiency with SQL data-validation queries, joins, and relational databases. Knowledge of ETL, data-integration, and source-to-target validation. Familiarity testing applications, reports, APIs, user interfaces, and data services. Understanding of Agile delivery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and iterative development.

Strong analytical, written communication, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Experience Federal healthcare, military healthcare, Department of Veterans Affairs, or other government health-program background. Knowledge of protected health information and HIPAA-aligned data practices.

Azure DevOps or a similar requirements and test-management platform. Exposure to cloud-hosted applications, databases, and data services. Healthcare data, reports, APIs, or interoperability workflows. Use of AI-assisted tools for requirements analysis, data profiling, test development, SQL validation, or defect investigation.

Why Rackner At Rackner , you will have the opportunity to build technology that supports critical healthcare and public-sector missions. You will work on more than isolated requirements or testing tasks.

This role combines hands-on data validation, automated testing, quality ownership, and close collaboration across software, data, cloud, and mission-focused teams. Rackner has delivered more than $30 million in recent federal awards and supports mission-critical work across defense, civilian, and public-sector environments.

We are looking for a senior BA/QA professional who can build on that momentum by improving data quality, strengthening delivery confidence, and helping teams produce dependable solutions with meaningful mission impact.

Senior QA Engineer - AI

Delta operates three AI products used by live traders: a customer support chatbot, an API Copilot that generates and executes trading scripts, and an MCP server. This role owns the quality of those products and is responsible for measuring it objectively.
Testing probabilistic systems differs fundamentally from testing deterministic ones. The same input produces different output on every run, an incorrect answer can be entirely fluent, and a prompt change in one flow can degrade another without any visible signal. The core of this role is establishing what correct means for these systems, building the datasets and scoring that measure it, and operating the release gate that prevents a regression from reaching customers.
This is an emerging discipline with no established playbook. We are defining the methodology as we build it, and the role carries a high degree of autonomy and ownership.
🔬 What Sets This Role Apart
Most QA roles that mention AI mean using AI to do testing faster: generating test cases from a PRD, healing flaky selectors, exploring an app with an agent. Those are useful and we do them.
This role is the other thing. The system under test is itself an AI, and the hard problem is deciding whether its output is correct when the same question produces a different answer every time and a wrong answer reads as convincingly as a right one. That means building evaluation datasets, defining what correct looks like, scoring against it, and defending a number that decides whether a release ships.
If you have spent time on the second problem, this role is built for you.

Build and maintain golden datasets for our AI products, trace mined from production or generated, and verified against a documented source of truth.
Design layered scoring for AI outputs: deterministic rules where behaviour can be asserted, and model-graded evaluation where it cannot.
Manage evaluation runs end to end: schedule and execute them against release candidates, compare results against prior baselines, and triage failures into product defects, incorrect expectations, and platform issues.
Own and operate the release gate that determines whether a prompt or model change is approved for production.
Identify failure modes ahead of customers, including hallucination, incorrect tool selection, loss of context across conversation turns, and PII exposure.
Investigate production traces to distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures from tool failures.
Convert findings into actionable engineering evidence and into permanent regression coverage.
Define and report quality metrics for AI surfaces, and drive improvement against them.

Swiss Arbeitgeber Award, Best of Swiss Apps oder Digital Economy Award. Unsere Arbeitsplatzkultur und unsere Projekte gewinnen Preise.
